headline: Epigenetic clocks and tensor models track methylation states across time and cell types
label: Epigenetic Clocks And State Modeling
summary: Recent preprints extend epigenetic clocks and state models toward cell-type, long-read and single-cell resolution.
synthesis: The common thread is computational modelling that resolves epigenetic measurements along time, cell type and read-level axes rather than bulk, population-level profiles. EpiState-T represents temporal epigenetic states as a tensor and is tested in simulations and on CpG methylation during reprogramming. In aging research, CheekAI builds an explainable deep learning clock on lifestyle and health biomarker proxies, trained on buccal methylation data with r=0.969. LongReadClock derives cell-type-resolved aging clocks from long-read whole-genome sequencing of bulk blood, classifying reads by methylation-based likelihood scoring. A subsampling framework for single-cell analysis, combined with robust contrastive learning, identifies eleven age-associated naive CD4 T cell subpopulations. What is new is the attempt to expose cell-type and state structure within methylation and single-cell data that bulk-level summaries leave unresolved.
